title: Define SourceIdentity JSON Schema
acceptance: Valid and invalid fixtures prove immutable identity, path-independent digest, media metadata, and schema version fields.

title: Define MeasurementRecord JSON Schema
acceptance: Schema separates measured value, unit, time support, parameters, implementation version, source identity, and tolerance policy.

title: Define EvidenceArtifact JSON Schema
acceptance: Evidence links immutable inputs and measurement records, carries provenance, and cannot masquerade as a judgment.

title: Define Judgment and Uncertainty schemas
acceptance: Judgment references but never overwrites measurements; UNCERTAIN and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE are valid outputs; severity and confidence are separate.

title: Create Ear v1 contract validator CLI
acceptance: CLI validates one artifact or a directory, returns nonzero on invalid input, and emits deterministic JSON evidence.

title: Build provenance manifest utility
acceptance: Utility hashes immutable inputs, records versions and parameters, writes atomically, and detects later source drift.

title: Define controlled WSE experiment manifest
acceptance: Manifest distinguishes transform, expected sensitivity/invariance, tolerances, negative controls, and evidence outputs.

title: Add deterministic synthetic fixture definitions
acceptance: Definitions are parameter-only, reproducible, contain no private audio, and cover silence, tone, impulse, clipping, phase inversion, and lossless rewrap controls.

title: Define experimental before-after comparison contract
acceptance: Contract is explicitly EXPERIMENTAL and records pairing, alignment, changed parameters, metrics, tolerance, and verification outcome.

title: Define experimental ProductionCase record
acceptance: Case preserves attempts, failures, evidence, rule/model versions, and human decision without claiming autonomous learning.

title: Design listening-review authority vocabulary
acceptance: Human approves vocabulary, override semantics, and validation population before implementation.

title: Create traceability integrity checker
acceptance: Checker rejects missing source, measurement, evidence, schema-version, or verification links and produces a reusable evidence report.
